description: This file implements string splitting utilities, including functions for splitting strings by delimiters, trimming whitespace, and handling key-value pairs. It is part of the 'base' namespace and references other base string utilities and ICU UTF functions.

methods.name: WhitespaceForType
methods.description: Template function returning whitespace characters for ASCII or UTF-16 based on character type.

methods.name: FindFirstOf
methods.description: Overloaded functions to find the first occurrence of a character or string in a string view, optimized for different character types.

methods.name: SplitStringT
methods.description: Template function that splits a string view into a vector of output strings based on delimiters and whitespace handling.

methods.name: AppendStringKeyValue
methods.description: Parses a key-value pair from a string view, separated by a delimiter, and appends to result.

methods.name: SplitStringUsingSubstrT
methods.description: Template function that splits a string view into substrings based on a delimiter, using substrings.
